AnnexIII.description:
Annex III high-risk areas (Art. 6(2) AIA).

Values double as short locators (``III.4.a`` = Annex III point 4(a)).
``UNSURE`` is the residual case: an Annex III area is implicated but the
specific point is unsettled. The engine treats it conservatively as
high-risk and routes it to review.
AnnexIII.title: AnnexIII

AnnexILegislation.description:
Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I AIA, as amended.

Values are locators: ``I.A.2`` is Annex I, Section A, point 2. Regulation
(EU) 2026/1744, Art. 1, point (41), deleted Section A, point 1 (Directive
2006/42/EC, machinery) and added Section B, point 21 (Regulation (EU)
2023/1230, machinery), so machinery is a Section B act and ``I.A.1`` does
not exist. The engine derives the section from the point; the reviewer only
names the legislation that covers the product.
AnnexILegislation.title: AnnexILegislation

AnnexISection.description:
Annex I sections for the Art. 6(1) AIA product route.

For a Section B product Art. 2(2) AIA lists only Art. 6(1), Art. 60a and
Arts. 102 to 112, and Arts. 57 to 59 only in so far as the high-risk
requirements have been integrated in the sectoral legislation; the report
keeps Art. 5, Art. 50 and any Annex III duties for review. Regulation (EU)
2026/1744 moved machinery to Section B:
Section A, point 1 is deleted and Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 is Section B,
point 21.
AnnexISection.title: AnnexISection

ChildSexualAbuseMaterialScreen.description:
Facts for Art. 5(1), first subparagraph, point (bb) AIA, with Art. 5(1a), which
apply from 2 December 2026 (Art. 113, third paragraph, point (a) AIA).

intended_purpose.description: The generation or manipulation is the intended purpose of the AI system (Art. 5(1a)(a)(i) AIA).
intended_purpose.title: Intended Purpose

foreseeable_and_reproducible.description: The system's design, training, architecture, capabilities or user-facing functionalities make the generation or manipulation a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome, without requiring significant technical modification (Art. 5(1a)(a)(ii) AIA).
foreseeable_and_reproducible.title: Foreseeable And Reproducible

adequate_safeguards.description: The system has reasonable and adequate technical safety measures and other safeguards to reliably prevent the generation or manipulation, taking into account reasonably foreseeable misuse, and to correct observed or reported misuse (Art. 5(1a)(a)(ii) AIA).
adequate_safeguards.title: Adequate Safeguards

deployer_uses_for_that_purpose.description: The deployer uses the system for the purpose of generating or manipulating the material or performance (Art. 5(1a)(b) AIA).
deployer_uses_for_that_purpose.title: Deployer Uses For That Purpose

generates_or_manipulates.description: The system generates or manipulates material or performance within the meaning of Art. 2, points (c) and (e), of Directive 2011/93/EU. True also where that is not its purpose but a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome, or a deployer's purpose in using it (Recital 12 of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744).
generates_or_manipulates.title: Generates Or Manipulates

without_right_defence_applies.description: A "without right" defence applies under national law. A fact the reviewer establishes; the engine does not evaluate national law.
without_right_defence_applies.title: Without Right Defence Applies

ChildSexualAbuseMaterialScreen.title: ChildSexualAbuseMaterialScreen

Derogation.description:
Art. 6(3) AIA derogation facts for an Annex III system.

An Annex III system is *not* high-risk if it does not pose a significant
risk of harm, but only where one of the four conditions holds AND the
system does not perform profiling of natural persons. Profiling always
keeps the system high-risk (Art. 6(3), third subparagraph, AIA).
Derogation.title: Derogation

ExcludedUse.description: Common AI Act scope exclusions or carve-outs that need visible review.
ExcludedUse.title: ExcludedUse

IntimateImageryScreen.description:
Facts for Art. 5(1), first subparagraph, point (ba) AIA, with Art. 5(1a) and (1b),
which apply from 2 December 2026 (Art. 113, third paragraph, point (a) AIA).

intended_purpose.description: The generation or manipulation is the intended purpose of the AI system (Art. 5(1a)(a)(i) AIA).
intended_purpose.title: Intended Purpose

foreseeable_and_reproducible.description: The system's design, training, architecture, capabilities or user-facing functionalities make the generation or manipulation a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome, without requiring significant technical modification (Art. 5(1a)(a)(ii) AIA).
foreseeable_and_reproducible.title: Foreseeable And Reproducible

adequate_safeguards.description: The system has reasonable and adequate technical safety measures and other safeguards to reliably prevent the generation or manipulation, taking into account reasonably foreseeable misuse, and to correct observed or reported misuse (Art. 5(1a)(a)(ii) AIA).
adequate_safeguards.title: Adequate Safeguards

deployer_uses_for_that_purpose.description: The deployer uses the system for the purpose of generating or manipulating the material or performance (Art. 5(1a)(b) AIA).
deployer_uses_for_that_purpose.title: Deployer Uses For That Purpose

generates_material.description: The system generates realistic images, videos, audio or similar material of an identifiable natural person's intimate parts, or of an identifiable natural person engaged in sexually explicit activities. True also where that is not its purpose but a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome, or a deployer's purpose in using it (Recital 12 of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744).
generates_material.title: Generates Material

manipulates_material_increasing_exposure.description: The system manipulates such material in a way that increases the exposure of any depicted intimate parts or alters the nature of any depicted sexually explicit activities. Other manipulation is not manipulation (Art. 5(1b) AIA).
manipulates_material_increasing_exposure.title: Manipulates Material Increasing Exposure

consent_ensured.description: The generation or manipulation takes place only with the depicted person's freely-given, specific, informed, unambiguous and explicit consent for it. Interpretation: read at system level for placing on the market and putting into service (docs/methodology.md).
consent_ensured.title: Consent Ensured

IntimateImageryScreen.title: IntimateImageryScreen

ProhibitedPractice.description: Prohibited practices (Art. 5(1) AIA), keyed to their letters.
ProhibitedPractice.title: ProhibitedPractice

Role.description: Operator roles under the AIA. A single company often holds several.
Role.title: Role

description: Structured description of an AI system with characterised facts.

assessment_date.description: The date of the placing on the market, putting into service or use under assessment. It decides whether a rule with a later application date applies (Art. 5(1)(ba) and (bb) AIA from 2026-12-02) and sets applies_on_assessment_date in the obligation graph. Null: those results stay open and go to review.
assessment_date.title: Assessment Date

placing_on_market_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the AI system was placed on the Union market. Drives Art. 111(2) and (4) AIA. For Art. 111(2) the date on which the first unit of that type and model was placed on the market or put into service decides (recital 39 of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744), not the date of a later unit. Null: not given.
placing_on_market_date.title: Placing On Market Date

putting_into_service_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the AI system was put into service. Drives Art. 111(2) AIA, for which the first unit of that type and model placed on the market or put into service decides (recital 39 of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744). Null: not given.
putting_into_service_date.title: Putting Into Service Date

significant_change_after_application_dat.description: Art. 111(2) AIA: whether the design of a system placed on the market or put into service before its Chapter III date has changed significantly as from that date. That date is contested: the report uses the Art. 113, third paragraph, point (c) date for the route (2027-12-02 for Annex III, 2028-08-02 for Annex I), but the general date of 2026-08-02 may be meant. Null: not established.
significant_change_after_application_dat.title: Significant Change After Application Date

deployer_public_authority.description: Art. 49(3) AIA: the deployer is a public authority, Union institution, body, office or agency, or acts on behalf of one. Read only where the profile holds the deployer role. Null: not established. The report then asks for the status and goes to review on every Annex III point where the result is high-risk, and on an Annex I route where the 2 August 2030 date of Art. 111(2) AIA may turn on it; the registration of use is inferred, for review, where the system is intended to be used by public authorities or its Annex III point (5(a), 6 or 7) describes such use.
deployer_public_authority.title: Deployer Public Authority

puts_name_or_trademark_on_system.title: Puts Name Or Trademark On System

training_flops.description: Cumulative training compute in FLOP; drives the Art. 51(2) systemic-risk presumption.
training_flops.title: Training Flops

gpai_model_placing_on_market_date.description: Art. 111(3) AIA: the date the general-purpose AI model itself was placed on the market. Null: the model is dated by placing_on_market_date, for review.
gpai_model_placing_on_market_date.title: Gpai Model Placing On Market Date

intimate_imagery.description: Element facts for Art. 5(1)(ba) AIA read with Art. 5(1a) and (1b). Null: not screened; for a system that generates synthetic content or deep fakes and does not declare 5.1.ba, that goes to review.

child_sexual_abuse_material.description: Element facts for Art. 5(1)(bb) AIA read with Art. 5(1a). Null: not screened; for a system that generates synthetic content or deep fakes and does not declare 5.1.bb, that goes to review.

annex_i_legislation.description: The Annex I AIA legislation covering the Art. 6(1) product, as a locator (I.B.21 is Annex I, Section B, point 21, machinery under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230). It decides the Annex I section. Null: annex_i_section is used.

annex_i_section.description: Annex I section of the Art. 6(1) AIA product, where annex_i_legislation is not given; it must match annex_i_legislation where both are. For Section B, Art. 2(2) AIA limits it to the provisions it lists; the report keeps Art. 5, Art. 50 and any Annex III duties for review. Null with no legislation: the report keeps the Section A duties and goes to review.

used_for_financial_fraud_detection.description: Annex III point 5(b) AIA excepts AI systems used for the purpose of detecting financial fraud. On a III.5.b profile, true (asserted) or null (unknown) raises a review question; the system stays high-risk until it is answered.
used_for_financial_fraud_detection.title: Used For Financial Fraud Detection
